ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite imagery and campus infrastructure monitoring tool built with Google Gemini API to automatically flag safety hazards, maintenance needs, and zoning compliance issues from drone or aerial shots.
ideas.title: GeminiLens Campus Compliance
ideas.track: Best Use Of Google Gemini API
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Google Gemini API theme while solving a concrete operational problem for college campuses like GCET, mirroring the real-world utility of GeoNex-ATLAS.

ideas.pitch: A rapid diagnostic pre-screening web app that ingests patient medical reports, lab results, and visual symptom images to generate structured clinical summaries and triage recommendations using Gemini's multimodal capabilities.
ideas.title: MultiModal MedScan AI
ideas.track: Best Use Of Google Gemini API
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages advanced multimodal capabilities of the Gemini API for healthcare data, following the winning pattern of Global-Smile.

ideas.pitch: An interactive dietary coach that processes real-time photo uploads of meals using Gemini to calculate macro-nutrients, spot allergens, and adaptively plan weekly student meal schedules based on budget.
ideas.title: AuraDiet Gemini Nutritionist
ideas.track: Best Use Of Google Gemini API
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines consumer utility with heavy multimodal utilization of the Gemini API, directly matching the fast-paced delivery and design style of E-Foodiee.

ideas.pitch: An educational video intelligence platform that ingests raw lecture recordings, indexes visual slides, extracts whiteboard diagrams using Gemini vision, and generates searchable knowledge bases with interactive quizzes.
ideas.title: TranscriptIQ Lecture Intelligence
ideas.track: Best Use Of Google Gemini API
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an acute student pain point by turning unstructured educational media into searchable structured data, matching LibrAI's winning formula.

ideas.pitch: An automated regulatory and financial transaction risk investigator that parses unstructured bank statements and legal documents using Gemini structured outputs to flag suspicious activity patterns.
ideas.title: Gemini AML Risk Screener
ideas.track: Best Use Of Google Gemini API
ideas.why_it_could_win: Brings rigorous domain-specific compliance workflows into an intuitive interface, reflecting the heavy engineering and explainability themes of Bito.
